G.A., Dheerendra Singh 
 Court No. - 11
 Hon'Ble Saurabh Lavania, J. 
(Criminal Misc. Application for Correction/I.A. No.25 of 2025) This is an application for correction
in the order dated 08.02.2024.
Learned counsel for the revisionist has submitted that due to inadvertent mistake in paragraph-2
and paragraph-9 of the order dated 28.08.2025, in place of Section 376-D I.P.C., Section 376 I.P.C.
has been typed.
The application for correction is allowed.

In paragraph - 2 and paragraph - 9 of the order dated 28.08.2025, in place of Section 376 I.P.C.,
Section 376-D I.P.C. shall be read.
The order dated 28.08.2025 stands modified to the aforesaid extent.

(Saurabh Lavania,J.) September 3, 2025 ML/-
 
Anuj Rawat Thru.
